title: Masters Edition II: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "Though Serra has not been seen for twenty years, her gargoyles still watch over our city and punish the guilty." —Gulsen, abbey matron
"Keep your chainmail, warrior. I have my own form of protection." —Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran priest
"I would say that our bureaucrats are no better than vipers—but I shouldn't insult the vipers." —Murat, death speaker
"A renegade rallying the rabble does not a true crusader make." —Irini Sengir
"Without combat medics, Icatia would probably not have withstood the forces of chaos as long as it did." —*Sarpadian Empires, vol. VI*
"I implore you not to forget the horrors of the past. You would have us start the Brothers' War anew!" —Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi heretic
"May they speed to their task, for the skyknights alone cannot hold Kjeldor safe." —Arna Kennerüd, skycaptain
Farrel and his followers became a formidable band of vigilantes, battling Icatians and followers of Tourach.

Even after the wall was breached in half a dozen places, the phalanxes fought on, standing solidly against the onrushing raiders. Disciplined and dedicated, they held their ranks to the end, even in the face of tremendous losses.
"Because the orc hordes attacked along the entire border, Scouts were essential to Icatia's defense." —*Sarpadian Empires, vol. VI*
"More than lessons may be gained from the past." —Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran priest
"In these troubled times, we alone carry the hope of reconciliation between Elf and Human." —Jaeuhl Carthalion, Juniper Order advocate
The winged helms of the guard are put on for pageants—but taken off for war.
"If we do our duty and uphold our honor, Kjeldor shall stand for a thousand years." —Arna Kennerüd, skyknight
"Let us remember brave Jarkeld and his troops, who perished in the Adarkar Wastes so long ago." —Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran priest
A blazing light to drive out the shadows.
"Shall we turn away a worthy soul because his parents were peasants? I think not." —Lucilde Fiksdotter, leader of the Order of the White Shield
"Thorn bushes spring up wherever the army has passed. Lean years follow in the wake of a great war." —Lao Tzu, Tao Te Ching, trans. Feng and English
"Let them send their legions! I will show them that my truth is stronger than their swords." —General Varchild
"The meek shall fight as one, and they shall overcome even the greatest of foes." —Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran priest
"Fortune does not side with the fainthearted." —Sophocles, Phaedra
"Divine gifts are granted to those who are worthy." —Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran priest
"You have almost completed your four years, my son. Soon you shall be a skyknight." —Arna Kennerüd, skyknight
"Faith is our greatest protector." —Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran priest
"The so-called barbarians will not respect us for our military might—they will respect us for our honor." —Lucilde Fiksdotter, leader of the Order of the White Shield
"The folk of the Karplusan mountains are impossible to ambush." —Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian chieftain
"I do love the rain . . . but this storm feels somehow wrong, Taysir." —Daria
"The very lands of Balduvia are alive." —Arna Kennerüd, skyknight
"What I want, I take." —Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran royal mage
"I reeled from the blow, and then suddenly, I knew exactly what to do. Within moments, victory was mine." —Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran royal mage
"Once great literature—now great litter." —Jaya Ballard, task mage
"The duel was going badly for me, and Zur thought I was finished. He boasted that he would eat my soul—but all he ate were his words." —Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran royal mage
"Worlds turn in crucial moments of decision. Make your choice." —Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran royal mage
Never underestimate the power of the soul unleashed.
"These sorcerers always seem to have another surprise up their sleeves." —Zur the Enchanter
"All the knowledge of Lat-Nam could not protect its sages from the Brothers' War." —Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen
"Magic overused can freeze the mind. Creativity is more important than power." —Zur the Enchanter
"Who needs a spear? Ya break off the horn, and ya stab the fish with it. Easy!" —Kakra, sea troll
By the battle of Red Cliffs in the year 208, the Wu kingdom controlled more than seven thousand warships on the Yangtze.
"It rose above our heads, above the ship, and still higher yet. No foggy, ice-laden sea in the world could frighten me more." —General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox
"Capturing this specimen was not easy. Study it well, that you someday might be as versatile." —Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen
"Relax. I'm sure it's just a snake hissing." —Avram Garrisson, leader of the Knights of Stromgald
Doing something at the last minute isn't so bad when you can make that minute last.
"The lemures had barely taken wing when the sky roared with thunder. The swarm of little beasts wavered, divided, and fell, crashing to the earth." —General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox
A fallen viscerid's only tribute is to be worn by a comrade.
Not all of Terisiare's flooding was natural . . . .
"Ya can eat it or ya can weave it, but ya can't fight in it." —Zeki, reef pirate
"To visit the sky requires bravery, and thought, and little else. To master the sky requires the binding of its masters, and little else." —Arnjlot Olasson, sky mage
"A mage must be precise as well as potent; cautious, as well as clever." —Zur the Enchanter
"The worst thing about being a mercenary for the Ebon Hand is having to wear a dead thrull." —Ivra Jursdotter
"The shamans of Marit Lage do her bidding in secret, but they do it gladly." —Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran priest
"Will not the mountains quake and hills melt at the coming of the darkness? Share this vision with your enemies, Lim-Dûl, and they shall wither." —Leshrac, Walker of Night
"Take their dead, and entomb them in the snow. Risen, they shall serve a new purpose." —Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer
"Wherever water is lacking, all things suffer." —Autumn Willow
"Serve me, and live forever." —Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer
"This party is such fun—but it's a shame to mourn just one." —Irini Sengir
"Rarely have power and madness been so delightfully wed as they have in our dear grandmother." —Baron Sengir
"When the earth shakes, and their animals are swallowed up by the ground, perhaps they will think twice before attacking again." —Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer
"Ihsan, the weak. Ihsan, the fallen. Ihsan, the betrayer. He has brought shame to the Serra paladins where none existed before. May his suffering equal his betrayal." —Baris, Serra inquisitor
"If Heaven has placed it in your hands, it means that the throne is destined to be yours."
"I thought the day had brought enough horrors for our ragged band, but the night was far worse." —Lucilde Fiksdotter, leader of the Order of the White Shield
"They shall kill those whom once they loved." —Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer
"Kjeldorans should rule supreme, and to the rest, death!" —Avram Garrisson, leader of the Knights of Stromgald
Some Krovikans find strength in the ears and eyes of their victims and wear such fetishes into battle.
"The guard will forever stand ready. For them, death is merely an inconvenience, not an ending." —Chaeska, Keeper of Tresserhorn
"When you cannot rely on your sources, trust your own senses. When you cannot trust those, you must follow your instincts." —Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian chieftain
Necrites killed Jherana Rure, ending the counterinsurgency.
"Rumors persist of dark deeds performed in the depths of Soldev. When will Dagsson heed the danger therein?" —Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi heretic
Not wind, but the breath of the dead.
"Kjeldor must be supreme at any cost." —Avram Garrisson, leader of the Knights of Stromgald
"Fair fight? I'll take survival over chivalry any day!" —Tor Wauki, Bandit King
"The shaman waved the staff, and the land itself went mad." —Disa the Restless, journal entry
"The An-Zerrins have served me well, ever since I first killed them." —Baron Sengir
"A whole skin is worth a thousand victories." —Orcish veteran of the Battle of Montford
"GOTCHA!" —Jaya Ballard, task mage
"Why do we trade with those despicable elves? You don't live in forests, you burn them!" —Avram Garrisson, leader of the Knights of Stromgald
"There is no shame in solitude. The lone knight may succeed where a hundred founder." —Arna Kennerüd, skyknight
"The spirit of the flame is the spirit of change." —Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian chieftain
"We were chasing Lim-Dûl when the ridge in front of us suddenly crumbled. I can't believe it was mere coincidence." —Lucilde Fiksdotter, leader of the Order of the White Shield
"AIIIEEEE!" —Ib Halfheart, goblin tactician
"Each generation teaches the next that artifice is the enemy of natural order." —Kaysa, elder druid of the Juniper Order
"Yes, I think 'toast' is an appropriate description." —Jaya Ballard, task mage
Generations of genetic weeding have given rise to the deviously cowardly Ironclaw clan.
"They aren't the brightest or the quickest of giants. For that matter, the same holds true if you compare them to rocks." —Disa the Restless, journal entry
"Overkill? This isn't a game of Kick-the-Ouphe!" —Jaya Ballard, task mage
"Eenie, meenie, minie, moe . . . oh, why not all of them?" —Jaya Ballard, task mage
"Your army must fear you more than the enemy. Only then will you triumph." —Malga Phlegmtooth
"It's a thankless job, and you'll probably die in an explosion. But the pay is pretty good." —Toothlicker Harj, orcish captain
There's a chance to win every battle.
"Yes, the farmers keep our soldiers fed. But why do they have to make every battlefield a pigpen?" —Toothlicker Harj, orcish captain
"How did I ever let myself get talked into this project?" —Toothlicker Harj, orcish captain
Unsuccessful in their early battle for Montford, the orcs quickly tempered their bloodlust with cowardice.
"If you'd been there, you would've run from that deer, too!" —Jaya Ballard, Task Mage
"Were they to reduce us to ash, we would clog their throats and sting their eyes in payment." —Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian chieftain
"Anybody want some . . . toast?" —Jaya Ballard, task mage
"The spirit of the stone is the spirit of strength." —Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian chieftain
"Trust in the power of stone. Stone is strong; stone shatters swords; stone breaks bones. Trust in stone." —Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian chieftain
"Every patch of land must belong to Kjeldor, no matter what the cost!" —General Varchild
One aurochs may feed a village, but a herd will flatten it.
"As the climate cooled, many elves turned to thallid farming for food, while the hunters honed their skills on what little game remained." —*Sarpadian Empires, vol. III*
"How can any human hope to match our skills? We are children of Fyndhorn, and its sap runs in our veins." —Taaveti of Kelsinko, elvish hunter
"We are never without guidance, if we but seek it." —Taaveti of Kelsinko, elvish hunter
"Freyalise has cleansed our bodies and minds of the plagues of Kjeldor; all she asks in return is that we keep pure our newly given home in Fyndhorn." —Kolbjörn, elder druid of the Juniper Order
"Born and bred of fungus, thallids were nearly impossible to kill." —*Sarpadian Empires, vol. I*
"Our friends of the forest take many forms, yet all serve the will of Freyalise." —Laina of the Elvish Council
In ashes are the gems of history.
"Thallids could absorb energy from the forest itself. Even elves were at a disadvantage in fighting them." —*Sarpadian Empires, vol. III*
"I breathed deeply, and suddenly I knew not who or where I was." —Taaveti of Kelsinko, elvish hunter
"Here in Fyndhorn, the goddess Freyalise is generous to her children." —Kolbjörn, elder druid of the Juniper Order
"To bring her down we must be on all sides at once—leave one avenue open and we'll all be dead." —Taaveti of Kelsinko, elvish hunter
Kaysa speaks as the elder druid, but Yavimaya recognizes only one voice: its own.
"I never question the Autumn Willow about her motives, not even when she turns people into lizards. It's her way." —Devin, faerie noble
The elves gathered huge piles of rot to grow fungus. Out of imitation or forethought, the thallids did the same.
"That which does not bend to the will of Freyalise shall surely break." —Kolbjörn, elder druid of the Juniper Order
"Do not fear adversity. Let your courage be your strength." —Onatah, Anaba shaman

"We could see the horizon blacken with the great beasts, but it was too late. The icefield offered no immediate safety, but luckily most of us reached a crevasse in which we could take cover." —Disa the Restless, journal entry
"The magic at the heart of all living things can bear awe-inspiring fruit." —Kolevi of Havenwood, elder druid
"Finally we understand the lesson of our home: loss begets renewal." —Kolbjörn, elder druid of the Juniper Order
"Mammoths may be good to ride on, but they're certainly bad to fall off of!" —Disa the Restless, journal entry
"We need not fear the forces of the air; I've yet to see a spider without an appetite." —Taaveti of Kelsinko, elvish hunter
"We orphans of Fyndhorn have found no welcome in this alien place." —Taaveti of Kelsinko, elvish hunter
"I have seen the true path. I will not warm myself by the fire—I will become the flame." —Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer
"It is the changing of perception that is important." —Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen
"Too many of us have died in the explosions that wrack these hills." —Klazina Jansdotter, leader of the Order of the Sacred Torch
"So large and so quiet—a combination best avoided." —Disa the Restless, journal entry
"Be open to the blessings, whatever their form." —Kaysa, elder druid of the Juniper Order
"The sea gives up her dead as easily as the soil." —Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer
"Come to us, with your lightning. Come to us, with your thunder. Serve us with your strength, and smite our foes with your power." —Steinar Icefist, Balduvian shaman
"For those of courage, even the sky holds no limit." —Arnjlot Olasson, sky mage
"We encountered the sentinels in the wastes, near no living thing. Their purpose was inscrutable." —Disa the Restless, journal entry
"Although fragile, the aeolipile could be quite destructive." —*Sarpadian Empires, vol. I*
Few remember that Ashnod's defilement of Terisiare's resources outstripped even that of her peers.
"We were not meant to have such terrible things. They should be left where we found them, if not destroyed!" —Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi heretic
Scholars are uncertain whether it was the actual sound or some other magical property of the elven lyre that transformed its player.
The very ground yielded to Mishra's wishes.
"The roterothoper is as insidious as it is ingenious. It is one of the few creations of our school that I take no pride in." —Baki, wizard attendant
"Let any who doubt the evil of using the ancient devices look at this infernal machine. What manner of fiend would design such a sadistic device?" —Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi heretic
"This ceaseless device has helped uncover marvels unreachable by mere flesh." —Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi machinist
They look human—until they bleed.
"Direct confrontation never was to the orcs' taste." —General Varchild
